text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday according to the official news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Air Algerie to resume flights to Paris on April 26.
- First meeting of independent commission in charge of monitoring June 5 parliamentary elections.
- Salah Boubnider, former military officer, elected by majority to head of elections watchdog committee.
- Finance minister pays surprise visit to Algiers port and orders seizure of goods kept past deadline.
- Algeria takes active part in meeting of Organisation of the Islamic Conference in Pakistan.
- Algerian team in Pakistan works to get support for broader condemnation of terrorism.
